description: Transactions admitted or refused by the topic manager's rules (docs/spec.md section 8.1), in the order given there. Each case is the transaction as raw hex and as BEEF (an unmined transaction's with its ancestry, a mined transaction's with its own proof and no parents), and the previous coins it is admitted with: the outputs the topic holds that its inputs spend, in input order, each with its outpoint (txid in display order), locking script and satoshis, as the overlay engine hands them to the topic manager. A carrier's funding output is read from its BEEF; an anchor token's spent outputs only from its previous coins. Admission runs against the headers below, the topic's stream, and the case's producer policy. scriptsVerify says whether the transaction's own inputs pass the script interpreter: the refusals where it is true are spends anyone could make without the key, which only these rules catch. rule names the frozen-list row a refusal exercises. Signatures are deterministic (RFC 6979), so the bytes are reproducible.
headersNote: merkleRoot is in display byte order, as a txid is printed

transactions.name: carrier-seq-1
transactions.note: a batch carrier: full-bytes lines, spending funding-tree output 0

transactions.name: carrier-seq-2
transactions.note: a batch carrier: full-bytes lines+gzip, spending funding-tree output 1; prev is carrier-seq-1's commitment

transactions.name: carrier-seq-3
transactions.note: a batch carrier: digest-only, spending funding-tree output 2; prev is carrier-seq-2's commitment

transactions.name: anchor-interval-1
transactions.note: the anchor token of interval 1 (seq 1 to 2), spending funding-tree output 3; mined

transactions.name: anchor-interval-2
transactions.note: the anchor token of interval 2 (seq 3), spending interval 1's token and funding-tree output 4 for its fee; mined

transactions.name: funding-tree
transactions.note: a mined funding tree: outputs 0 to 4 are funding outputs and are admitted; output 5 is change

transactions.name: funding-tree-unmined
transactions.note: the same funding tree with no proof: it claims nothing and admits nothing

transactions.name: sweep
transactions.note: a mined sweep of funding-tree outputs 0 and 1: its tombstone, output 0, is admitted as a funding output; it retracts carrier-seq-1 and carrier-seq-2

transactions.name: carrier-closed-policy-admits
transactions.note: carrier-seq-1 under a closed policy that names its producer

transactions.name: carrier-two-inputs
